title: Protocol for Proteome Extraction from Norway Spruce Bark Samples
author: Marcelo Ramires
materials: Carefully remove and discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Grind Bark Samples
steps.instruction: Grind frozen bark samples into fine dust using an IKA mill, ensuring samples remain frozen throughout the process.

steps.title: Prepare Sample and Inhibit Phenolics
steps.instruction: Weigh 100 mg of the sample, transfer it into a 2 ml microcentrifuge tube, and add 10 mg of PVPP to inhibit phenolic compounds.

steps.title: Initial Lysis and Incubation
steps.instruction: Mix the sample with TRIzol™ reagent and DTT, then incubate for 5 minutes at room temperature.

steps.title: Clarify Lysate
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the lysate at 12,000 × g for 5 minutes at 4°C and carefully transfer the clear supernatant to a new tube.

steps.title: Phase Separation
steps.instruction: Separate the proteins from the lysate using chloroform.

substeps.instruction: Add 0.2 mL of chloroform per 1 mL of TRIzol™ reagent used.
Shake vigorously to mix.
Incubate for 5 minutes at room temperature.
Centrifuge at 12,000 x g for 15 minutes at 4°C.
Carefully transfer the organic phase (containing proteins) to a new tube, avoiding contamination from the aqueous phase.

steps.title: Protein Precipitation
steps.instruction: Precipitate proteins using ethanol and isopropanol.

substeps.instruction: Add 0.3 mL of 100% ethanol per 1 mL of TRIzol™ reagent used.
Mix and incubate for 5 minutes at room temperature.
Centrifuge at 12,000 x g for 5 minutes at 4°C.
Transfer the supernatant to a new tube.
Add 1.5 mL of isopropanol per 1 mL of TRIzol™ reagent to the supernatant.
Incubate with end-over-end rotation overnight at 4°C.
Centrifuge at 12,000 x g for 10 minutes at 4°C and discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Wash Protein Pellet
steps.instruction: Clean the protein pellet through repeated washing.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet in 2 mL of wash solution and incubate for 20 minutes at room temperature.
Centrifuge at 10,000 x g for 10 minutes at 4°C and discard the supernatant.
Repeat these washing steps twice more for a thorough cleaning.

steps.title: Final Ethanol Wash and Drying
steps.instruction: Perform a final ethanol wash and air dry the pellet.

substeps.instruction: Add 2 mL of 100% ethanol to the pellet and vortex to mix.
Incubate for 20 minutes at room temperature.
Centrifuge at 10,000 x g for 10 minutes at 4°C.
Allow the pellet to air dry for 5 minutes, avoiding over-drying to the point of cracking.

steps.title: Protein Resuspension
steps.instruction: Resuspend the protein pellet in Urea buffer.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet in 50 μL of Urea buffer containing 50 mM DTT and proteinase inhibitors.
Allow proteins to resuspend at room temperature for one hour.
Incubate with end-over-end rotation overnight at 4°C.
